author: Reuters
description: WASHINGTON—Verizon Communications said late on Wednesday it had restored mobile phone service and planned to offer affected consumers credits for a 10-hour outage that disrupted calls, texting and internet usage for hundreds of thousands of customers. “Today, we let many of our customers down and for that, we are truly sorry,” Verizon said. “The outage […]
title: Verizon Resolves Network Outage Issue That Affected Hundreds of Thousands
